title: 彭博经济学家曲天石：信贷数据疲软，政策加码信号已现
speaker: David Qu

segments.en: June credit is the latest sign that the economy needs stronger support from the PBOC.
segments.zh: 6月信贷数据是最新信号，显示经济需要央行更强支持。

segments.en: Everyone's watching the Politburo meeting now, maybe for the next sort of course of action.
segments.zh: 所有人都在关注政治局会议，期待下一步政策方向。

segments.en: But was the credit data, plus what we got yesterday? Was it soft enough to finally see some stimulus, you think?
segments.zh: 但信贷数据加上昨天的数据，是否疲软到足以触发刺激措施？

segments.en: Well, I think the data and the credit is already enough for the PBOC and the fiscal side to push the economy harder.
segments.zh: 我认为数据和信贷已经足以让央行和财政方面加大经济推动力度。

segments.en: But the thing is that whether we can see it soon. Because we have been there, I mean the policy stance has been there for a long time.
segments.zh: 但问题是能否很快看到行动。因为政策立场已经维持了很久。

segments.en: And it seems that the authorities are not so in the hurry to push it. Yes, that is why we are looking at the upcoming Politburo meeting to see whether the top leaders will allow or let the PBOC to do that.
segments.zh: 当局似乎并不急于推动。是的，所以我们关注即将召开的政治局会议，看高层是否会允许央行行动。

segments.en: And if we read the early sign from the state council, it already called for more accommodative policies. And also for the so-called anti-sacredical adjustments. So I think that is the early sign.
segments.zh: 从国务院的早期信号看，已经要求更宽松的政策，以及所谓的逆周期调节。我认为这是早期信号。

segments.en: But the thing is that what time they will do it? Well, aren't interest rates, for example? Are they accommodative enough? Like what more could we see?
segments.zh: 但问题是什么时候行动？比如利率，是否已经足够宽松？我们还能看到什么？
